fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
h = ax.hist2d(gaze[:, 0], gaze[:, 1], bins=[64, 36],

ax.set_title('Gaze heatmap (attention density)')
fig.colorbar(h[3], ax=ax, label='samples per bin')
